appliedAreaAnchor.finding: The named museum area represents Borgarsyssel Museum and the immediate outdoor museum and ruin-park complex.

officialIdentity.finding: The official museum describes a county-wide open-air museum with 25 buildings, St. Nikolas church ruins, the ruin park and interpretation of the medieval city Borg.

officialAddress.finding: The official visitor and postal address identifies the present museum destination.

medievalScope.finding: The museum is located beside St. Nikolas church ruins. The official description distinguishes the museum and ruin park from the 1702 landslide scar where much of the medieval town Borg lay.

independentCrossCheck.finding: The independent published museum coordinate is approximately 21.7 metres from the applied area anchor.

radiusDecision.finding: The retained radius covers the museum buildings, Olavs hall, tower, Nikolaikirken ruins, ruin park and nearby historical landscape at gameplay scale. It is not the boundary of the medieval city Borg, the museum property or the landslide area.

decision.representationLimit: The marker represents Borgarsyssel Museum and the immediate Olavsbyen and church-ruin interpretation complex. It does not claim an exact centre or boundary for the whole medieval city Borg.
